heroSummary: Shawnee Mission students start the 2027–28 school year on different days depending on grade. Grades 1–7 and 9 start Thursday, August 12; grades 8 and 10–12 start August 13; and Pre-K and kindergarten start Monday, August 16 after conferences on August 12–13. Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, Winter Break December 22–January 3, and Spring Break March 13–17. Pre-K finishes May 22, while grades K–11 finish with early dismissal on May 23.

calendarNotes: SMSD uses three opening dates, not one universal first day. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin August 12, with early dismissal for grades 1–6; grades 8 and 10–12 begin August 13; Pre-K and kindergarten begin August 16 after conferences August 12–13. SMSD’s four quarter counts total 172 student days, but individual grade groups do not all share the same first and last attendance dates. Fall evening conferences cover grades 7–12 on October 13 and Pre-K–6 on October 14; spring evening conferences cover grades 9–12 on February 9 and Pre-K–8 on February 10. All Pre-K–12 students are out October 15 and February 11 for conferences. Pre-K does not attend December 21 and finishes May 22. Grades K–11 finish with early dismissal May 23. The calendar gives graduation dates and host sites but not an explicit districtwide senior last day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Shawnee Mission students start school on the same day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–7 and 9 begin August 12, grades 8 and 10–12 begin August 13, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin August 16 after conferences on August 12–13.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the Shawnee Mission Pre-K and kindergarten conference days regular school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Pre-K and kindergarten conferences are August 12–13, and students begin classes Monday, August 16. Families should use their school communication for appointment details.
